answer_2.quote: Here, we adopt three popular metrics from multi-label classification : label-F1 (average F1 over labels), instance-F1 (average F1 over instances), and hamming loss measured on the predicted and groundtruth label sequences.

answer_4.quote: Here 96 test hashtags were sampled and two native Chinese speakers were invited to select the first three emotions occurred to them. ... We find model performance is better than human results, suggesting the possible bias of individual thoughts from public viewpoints. Then, we asked the same annotators to review the hashtags and their emotions from votes, where they thought 75% and 76% voted emotions make sense to them.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to (1) select the three emotions they felt for each hashtag and (2) judge whether the voted emotions from the crowd make sense for the hashtag.
